rounds.text: Aarnav Fashions Ltd presents a compelling valuation gap, trading at a price-to-book ratio of just 0.76x (price ₹ 35.2 on a book value of ₹ 46.5) [E2], which is significantly below the sector benchmark of 1.31x [E7]. This deep value is supported by strong cash generation, highlighted by an operating cash flow of Rs 21 Cr [E34], a free cash flow of Rs 6 Cr [E35], and an exceptional cash conversion rate of 2.33x for March 2026 [E33]. Furthermore, the company's long-term fundamentals are robust, with a 10-year compounded sales growth of 96% [E14] and a 3-year compounded profit growth of 175% [E20], indicating that historical business performance is outpacing the stock price [E53]. A discounted cash flow analysis highlights this under-appreciation, estimating an intrinsic value of Rs 64 per share against the current market price of Rs 35.2 [E43], which provides a substantial 45.3% margin of safety [E44]. Conceded: [E4], [E13], [E27], the company has a 0.00% dividend yield, a recent return on equity of 4.8%, and a median return on equity over 3 years of 4%. However, the stock's strong market momentum, reflected in a relative-strength rating of 100 against the Nifty 500 [E49] and trading just -2.5% away from its 52-week high [E47], suggests the market is beginning to recognize this underlying value.
